iti92:2.1: saṅghāṭikaṇṇe cepi bhikkhave bhikkhu gahetvā piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandho assa pāde pādaṃ nikkhipanto
iti92:2.2: so ca hoti abhijjhālu kāmesu tibbasārāgo byāpannacitto paduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo muṭṭhassati asampajāno asamāhito vibbhantacitto pākatindriyo
iti92:2.3: atha kho so ārakā va mayhaṃ ahañca tassa.
iti92:2.5: dhammaṃ hi so bhikkhave bhikkhu na passati
iti92:3.1: yojanasate cepi so bhikkhave bhikkhu vihareyya
iti92:3.2: so ca hoti anabhijjhālu kāmesu na tibbasārāgo abyāpannacitto appaduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo upaṭṭhitasati sampajāno samāhito ekaggacitto saṃvutindriyo
iti92:3.3: atha kho so santikeva mayhaṃ ahañca tassa.
iti92:3.5: dhammaṃ hi so bhikkhave bhikkhu passati
